task.description: Produce design artefact at src/design/oidcf2-subdomain-routing.md for OIDC-F-05 and OIDC-F-06. Cover: (1) new DB migration: tenant_hostnames table with columns tenant_id UUID FK, hostname TEXT UNIQUE NOT NULL; (2) backend Zig module src/api/routes/tenant_config.zig with public fn handleTenantConfig, error set, response type TenantConfigResponse { oidc_authority: []const u8, client_id: []const u8 }; (3) how the route resolves: join tenant_hostnames -> oidc_realm_bindings to get the realm, construct authority URL as KEYCLOAK_BASE_URL + /realms/ + realm_name, use default realm if no hostname match; (4) how GET /api/tenant-config is wired into the router (public, no auth middleware); (5) frontend: TenantConfigStore (Zustand or module singleton) with fetchTenantConfig(hostname) function, how OidcManager.ts is refactored to lazy-init (call getTenantConfig() before signinRedirect), how AppShell or main.tsx calls fetchTenantConfig on startup before rendering routes.
acceptance_criteria: Design covers all OIDC-F-05 and OIDC-F-06 acceptance criteria

result.summary: Design artefact produced at src/design/oidcf2-subdomain-routing.md covering: migration 050_tenant_hostnames.sql, backend tenant_config.zig route handler, router registration pattern, frontend tenantConfig.ts module, OidcManager.ts async refactor, AppRoot startup pre-warm, and open constraints.
